newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PORRINI TO LEAVE JUVENTUS FOR RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORRINI TO LEAVE JUVENTUS FOR RANGERS.

text.p: Juventus defender Sergio Porrini is joining Glasgow Rangers on a four-year contract, sources at the Italian league champions said on Monday.
Porrini has played at Juventus for the past four seasons. Sources said a deal had been agreed between the two clubs for around $5.7 million.
Rangers signed another Italian, defender Lorenzo Amoruso, from Fiorentina last month, also on a four-year contract.
